output.reason: [ev-3faa5287ea4e] says the ConsulCatalog `namespace` option is removed in v3 and would stop Traefik from starting. Its examples show the option set in three places: a YAML file, a TOML file and the CLI flag `--consulCatalog.namespace`. The proposed condition flags an environment when the option is set in any of these places, plus the matching environment variable, and does not flag environments that only use `namespaces`. The file patterns can't be limited to the consulCatalog section, so they may also match a `namespace` line under another provider. The environment-variable name is inferred from naming rules rather than stated in the evidence. These are the reasons for low confidence.
